title: Beacon flush + copy-swap have no coverage despite spec task; test header cites a bug-hunt scenario that doesn't exist
evidence:
spec-form-save-resume-f3.md:93: '- [ ] Tests — JS: `scripts/js-tests/form_draft.test.js` (serializer/debounce/beacon/copy-swap), extend `form_stepper.test.js` + `apply_analytics.test.js`; ...'
form_draft.test.js:8-9: '// writes" rule. The browser choreography (fetch, beacon, button injection)
// is covered E2E by the canonical bug-hunt scenario for save-and-resume.'
Verified absent: `grep -rln "continue-link|save-and-resume|form-resume|draft-continue" .claude/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/` returns no matches (exit 1), and `git show --name-only HEAD` lists all 42 PR files — none is a .yaml scenario.
detail: Spec task scopes form_draft.test.js to beacon/copy-swap coverage; the file defers both to a save-and-resume bug-hunt scenario absent from the repo (grep confirms). Frozen-matrix pagehide flush and the JS copy-swap acceptance criterion are untested; the comment misstates coverage.
recommended_fix: Either add the bug-hunt scenario the comment cites (preferred — covers fetch/beacon/button choreography E2E) or extend form_draft.test.js with DOM-faked beacon/copy-swap tests, and correct the comment plus the unchecked spec task.

(router.gleam:790-793 routes both PUT and POST to handle_save_draft, so this works.)
detail: Frozen I/O matrix (human-owned intent) says the debounced save is a PUT; the client sends POST. Router accepts both so nothing breaks, but spec text and code now disagree and the spec change log doesn't record the deviation.
recommended_fix: Send PUT for the debounced fetch save (keeping POST only for the sendBeacon flush, which requires it), or amend the frozen matrix's Save row to POST and note the refinement in the spec change log.
